misc.text: #ONEPIECE1189 I know we all saw the 19 weapons in the Throne Room (or perhaps they are just symbols for the World Government's weapons), but what if the Donquixote Family's weapon was a gun? It was a key characteristic of Doflamingo, after all that’s how he shot Corazon and Law. Plus, we saw Imu turn his weapon into a gun to free Gunko. What if the Donquixote Family's weapon is a pistol?

misc.title: #ONEPIECE1189 The point is Imu is not a boss you can overcome by sheer strength of a single person. He is a world boss that requires certain things to align for the win con You can't beat Kaguya witho
misc.text: #ONEPIECE1189 The point is Imu is not a boss you can overcome by sheer strength of a single person. He is a world boss that requires certain things to align for the win con You can't beat Kaguya without the Brothers seal,You can't beat Voldemort without taking out the Horcruxes WorstGenHQ (@WorstGenHQ) #ONEPIECE1189 This statement by Shanks is hugely significant. This is the same guy who saw Roger and Whitebeard fight, who battled Mihawk and Teach himself, and who witnessed Haki at the highest level yet, according to him, no one even comes close to Imu's power level. — https://nitter.net/WorstGenHQ/status/2081704913642422282#m
